## Services & Pricing

### Ceramic Coating Dubai
Professional nano-ceramic coating using SiO2 (silicon dioxide) technology. Creates a permanent hydrophobic, UV-resistant, chemical-resistant protective layer bonded to the paintwork.
- Starting price: AED 1,500 (standard sedan, 2-year package)
- Premium price: AED 8,500+ (luxury/exotic, 10-year elite package)
- Warranty: 2 to 10 years depending on tier
- Products used: GYEON, Ceramic Pro, IGL Coatings

### Graphene Coating Dubai
Advanced graphene-enhanced ceramic coating. Superior to standard ceramic for Dubai's climate: anti-static (repels dust), better heat dissipation, lower water contact angle, and higher water-spot resistance.
- Starting price: AED 2,500
- Warranty: 5–10 years
- Best choice for Dubai's dusty environment

### Paint Protection Film (PPF) Dubai
Xpel Authorized PPF installation. Self-healing thermoplastic urethane film physically protects against rock chips, scratches, and road debris.
- Starting price: AED 2,500 (partial coverage)
- Full body: AED 8,000–15,000 depending on vehicle size
- Warranty: 10-year manufacturer warranty
- Brands: Xpel Ultimate Plus, SunTek Ultra, 3M Pro Series

### Interior Ceramic Coating
Ceramic coating applied to leather seats, dashboard plastics, fabric, glass, and all interior trim surfaces. Provides UV protection against cracking and fading, stain resistance, and easy-clean hydrophobic properties.
- Starting price: AED 800
- Warranty: 2–5 years

### Paint Correction Dubai
Multi-stage machine polishing to remove swirl marks, light scratches, water etching, and oxidation from clear coat. Required before ceramic coating for perfect results.
- Starting price: AED 1,200
- Duration: 4–8 hours depending on condition

### Exterior Detailing Dubai
Professional exterior hand wash, decontamination (iron removal, clay bar), drying, and protection.
- Starting price: AED 250
- Duration: 2–3 hours

### Interior Detailing Dubai
Full interior vacuum, steam cleaning, leather conditioning, dashboard dressing, and fabric protection.
- Starting price: AED 400
- Duration: 2–4 hours

### Window Tinting Dubai
UAE RTA-compliant window film installation using Xpel Prime, SunTek CXP, or 3M Crystalline. Front windows minimum 30% VLT as per UAE law.
- Starting price: AED 600

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is ceramic coating and how does it work?**
A: Ceramic coating is a liquid polymer made from silicon dioxide (SiO2) that chemically bonds with car paint at a molecular level, forming a hard, hydrophobic, UV-resistant protective layer. It's more durable than wax or sealants, lasting 2–10 years professionally applied.

**Q: How much does ceramic coating cost in Dubai?**
A: Ceramic coating Dubai prices start from AED 1,500 for a standard 2-year package on a small sedan, up to AED 8,500+ for a premium 10-year elite package on a luxury or exotic car. Price depends on vehicle size, paint condition, and coating tier.

**Q: Is ceramic coating worth it in Dubai?**
A: Yes. Dubai's UV Index reaches 11+ (extreme), sandstorms deposit abrasive particles, bird droppings etch paint within minutes in 45°C heat, and hard mineral water causes water spots. Ceramic coating protects against all these conditions and preserves resale value.

**Q: What is the best ceramic coating for cars in Dubai?**
A: Graphene coating is best for Dubai's specific conditions due to anti-static properties that repel dust, superior heat dissipation in extreme temperatures, and high water-spot resistance. For budget-conscious protection, ceramic coating is the ideal all-rounder starting from AED 1,500.

**Q: Can ceramic coating be applied to car interior?**
A: Yes. Interior ceramic coating protects leather seats, dashboard, fabric, glass, and trim against UV fading, stains, and heat damage. Starting from AED 800. Especially valuable in Dubai where cabin temperatures reach 70°C+ in summer.

**Q: Where can I get ceramic coating near me in Dubai?**
A: Ceramic My Car is located in Al Quoz, accessible from all Dubai areas: Dubai Marina (15 min), Business Bay (10 min), JVC (15 min), Palm Jumeirah (20 min), Downtown (12 min). Free vehicle pickup available for orders over AED 3,000.

**Q: Do you serve Abu Dhabi and Ajman?**
A: Yes. We serve customers across the UAE including Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, and Ras Al Khaimah. Vehicle collection available for Abu Dhabi orders over AED 5,000. Our Al Quoz studio is approximately 90 minutes from Abu Dhabi city centre.

**Q: What is nano ceramic coating?**
A: Nano ceramic coating and ceramic coating are the same product. "Nano" refers to the nanotechnology: SiO2 particles are engineered at the nanometer scale to penetrate microscopic paint pores and bond permanently. All professional ceramic coatings today use nano technology.

**Q: What is PPF and where can I get it near me in Dubai?**
A: PPF (Paint Protection Film) is a self-healing thermoplastic urethane film that physically protects paint from rock chips, scratches, and debris. Ceramic My Car is an Xpel Authorized Dealer in Al Quoz, Dubai, offering PPF near you in 10–25 minutes from any Dubai community.

**Q: How long does ceramic coating last in Dubai?**
A: Standard ceramic coating lasts 2–5 years in Dubai's harsh climate. Premium coatings last 7–10 years. Dubai's extreme UV is the main factor reducing longevity compared to milder climates.

**Q: What is graphene coating and how is it different from ceramic?**
A: Graphene coating adds graphene (the world's strongest, thinnest material) to the ceramic SiO2 formula. Results: higher hardness, greater flexibility, anti-static properties that dramatically reduce dust adhesion in Dubai's dusty environment, lower water contact angle, and better heat dissipation.

**Q: How much does PPF cost in Dubai?**
A: PPF pricing starts from AED 2,500 for partial coverage (front bumper, hood strip) and ranges to AED 8,000–15,000 for full-body coverage on luxury vehicles. We use Xpel Ultimate Plus, the highest-rated PPF film globally, with computer-cut patterns for a precise fit.
